pwsh -NoProfile -Command '
Import-Module PSSQLite -MaximumVersion 1.99.99 -Force
. ./api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1
$db = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("qadj_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".db")
$fail = 0
function Check($name,$cond){ if($cond){Write-Host "PASS $name"}else{Write-Host "FAIL $name";$script:fail++} }
try {
  Initialize-PantryStore -DataSource $db
  $a = New-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Name "Milk" -Quantity 3 -Threshold 2
  $b = New-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Name "Eggs" -Quantity 1 -Threshold 1

  $r = Update-PantryItemQuantity -DataSource $db -Id $a.id -Delta 1
  Check "increment 3->4" ([double]$r.quantity -eq 4)

  $r = Update-PantryItemQuantity -DataSource $db -Id $a.id -Delta -1
  Check "decrement 4->3" ([double]$r.quantity -eq 3)

  # clamp at 0: eggs qty 1, delta -1 -> 0, delta -1 again -> stays 0
  $r = Update-PantryItemQuantity -DataSource $db -Id $b.id -Delta -1
  Check "eggs 1->0" ([double]$r.quantity -eq 0)
  $r = Update-PantryItemQuantity -DataSource $db -Id $b.id -Delta -1
  Check "clamp at 0 (no negative)" ([double]$r.quantity -eq 0)

  # persistence: re-read from storage
  $persist = Get-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Id $a.id
  Check "persisted milk=3" ([double]$persist.quantity -eq 3)

  # other fields preserved
  Check "name preserved" ([string]$persist.name -eq "Milk")
  Check "threshold preserved" ([double]$persist.threshold -eq 2)

  # missing id -> null
  $r = Update-PantryItemQuantity -DataSource $db -Id 99999 -Delta 1
  Check "missing id returns null" ($null -eq $r)

  # cross-threshold: milk qty 3 threshold 2 (not low); drop to 2 -> now low
  $before = @(Select-PantryLowStockItems -Items @(Get-PantryItems -DataSource $db)).Where({$_.id -eq $a.id}).Count
  Update-PantryItemQuantity -DataSource $db -Id $a.id -Delta -1 | Out-Null   # 3->2
  $after = @(Select-PantryLowStockItems -Items @(Get-PantryItems -DataSource $db)).Where({$_.id -eq $a.id}).Count
  Check "milk not low before" ($before -eq 0)
  Check "milk low after crossing threshold" ($after -eq 1)
}
finally { Remove-Item $db -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
if($fail -gt 0){ Write-Host "`n$fail FAILURES"; exit 1 } else { Write-Host "`nALL STORE ASSERTIONS PASS" }'
